test_objective: Check that one can filter attribute instances of a temporal entity based on datasetId.
keywords: Filter attribute instances of a temporal entity based on datasetId

test_cases.name: 021_18_01 filter based on attrs only
test_cases.doc: Check that one can filter attribute instances of a temporal entity based on datasetId.
test_cases.template: Filter attribute instances of a temporal entity based on datasetId
test_cases.then:
then {
    the SUT sends a valid Response for the operations:
        Query Temporal Representation Of Entities with Response Status Code set to 200     and
        Query Temporal Representation Of Entities with Response Body containing EntityTemporal element containing attribute instances in the time range specified by the NGSI-LD temporal query:
            * the payload is defined in the file set to 'vehicle-temporal-representation-speed-attribute.json'
            * the id was changed to 'temporal_entity_representation_id=${temporal_entity_id}'
            * response body to be checked set to 'response_body=${response.json()}'
}
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/temporal/entities'
        method set to 'GET'
        Query Temporal Representation of Entities and
    Query Parameter: attrs set to '${attrsToMatch}' and
    Query Parameter: datasetId set to '${datasetId}' and
    Query Parameter: entity_types set to 'Vehicle' and
    Query Parameter: timerel set to '${timerel}' and
    Query Parameter: timeAt set to '${timeat}' and
    Query Parameter: context set to 'https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld' and
    Query Parameter: options set to 'temporalValues'
}
